cards.title: Why an adapter is needed
items: The HPA reads metrics only through the Kubernetes metrics APIs, not from Prometheus directly
Prometheus Adapter registers an APIService for custom.metrics.k8s.io and external.metrics.k8s.io
Its rules map PromQL queries onto metric names the HPA can reference

cards.title: Custom versus external metrics
items: Custom metrics attach to a Kubernetes object, such as requests per second on a Deployment
External metrics come from outside the cluster, such as SQS queue depth
KEDA covers the external case with a wider set of built-in scalers

cards.title: Operational notes
items: kubectl get --raw /apis/custom.metrics.k8s.io/v1beta1 confirms the API is serving
Scrape interval plus adapter cache means the HPA reacts on the order of tens of seconds
Set behavior.scaleDown.stabilizationWindowSeconds to avoid thrash on noisy metrics
